function.name: send_get_request
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data based on the provided parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent.

timeout.description: The maximum number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials as an array where the first element is the username and the second is the password.

cert.description: Path to a cert file or key for SSL verification.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol to the proxy URL.

stream.description: Indicates if the response should be streamed (True) or immediately downloaded (False).

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.
